test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A x B means ‘A is the father of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A ÷ B means ‘A is the son of B’ and

A + B means ‘A is the brother of B’.

How is K related to Q if ‘K x M − N + P ÷ Q’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 x
 −
 +
 ÷
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 Father
 Mother
 Brother
 Son
 
 

Given: K x M − N + P ÷ Q

It means: K is the father of M, M is the mother of N, N is the brother of P, and P is the son of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5069343949fe08f8c7e2f55ea8aceba62b2cba5fee419f3a4dc8e8fa7f1ac09a.png] 

 

Now, K is the father of Q’s wife.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
